title: After an answer: clear the question from the row and pane, and say the role resumed

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S31 (2026-10-25, S78 run ork-20261025-175709-e8c9): after the owner answered in the pane, the run resumed the implementer (round 2), but the Running row and the pane header still showed the question text ('Full-suite verification remains necessary...'), and the pane footer showed the CLI form 'ork answer RUN TEXT: pending' and stayed on pending after the role resumed. The Running row also starts with a wide blank gap (the empty label noted in S84's later notes).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/runs.go:934-935` (wait text): clear it when the pending question is answered.
- `internal/tui/pane.go` (footer and header) and `internal/tui/model.go` (the answer result): show "answered; implementer resumed (round N)" in plain words, not the CLI command; drop it on the next state change.
- `internal/tui/overview.go` (Running row): no question text while the run is not paused; no blank label gap.
- Tests beside each; goldens `testdata/golden/pane-*.txt`, Overview goldens.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Coordinate with S111 (structured questions rework the pane) and S109 (pane follow): run after S111 or fold into it at preflight. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

Owner decision (2026-10-25): run after S111 lands, not folded into it.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/daemon ./internal/tui; goldens; slicer check; adj lint.
